title: Wrapped in Lotus Leaf Italian Sweet Sausage and Chicken Focaccia
description: A one-pot Italian dish featuring brown sugar, steam, and a hint of umami, wrapped in a crispy lotus leaf.

ingredients.name: Lotus leaves
ingredients.notes: Fresh lotus leaves for wrapping the focaccia

instructions: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the Italian sweet sausage and brown sugar to the skillet and cook, breaking up the sausage with a spoon, until the sausage is no longer pink, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken breast to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and cook for 10-12 minutes, until the focaccia is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Transfer the focaccia to a cutting board and let it cool slightly.
Transfer the focaccia to a serving plate and top with fresh basil and grated Parmesan cheese.
Cut the focaccia into slices and serve hot, wrapped in lotus leaves if desired.
